producer_report.summary: "try again on <job>" now works. `ask` (and `go` on a queued request, a correction, or a configuration re-read) detects the phrase at the start of a request, case-insensitively. It resolves the job, which must be rejected. It carries that job's request and final verification findings and reasons into a new "Earlier attempt" section of the reader's brief. The carried text is redacted. The new job's request stays as typed. A landed, in-flight, or unknown job, or one missing its request or verification, is refused with an error naming the job and its state. Unknown jobs get the existing "no job matches ..." error.

checks_run.note: Includes the new briefs unit test and the two new lifecycle tests.

open_issues: The brief says the first whitespace-delimited token after the phrase is the job reference, with trailing punctuation stripped. Any text after it is ignored.
The function `earlier_attempt` lives in reading.rs (pub). I did not change lib.rs, though the deliverables list it.
I added a call in run.rs (`reread_after_configuration_change`), which the deliverables don't list. It was needed because read_for gained a parameter.
The lifecycle tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs, not athena-core/tests/lifecycle.rs as the deliverables list.
learnings: There is no crates/athena-core/tests/; the lifecycle tests and the Fixture they use are in crates/athena-cli/tests, because the fixture needs athena_cli::wiring. The new tests went there.

A job's state comes from JobRecords::state(). Rejected is JobState::Closed(OutcomeState::Rejected). The final verification is JobRecords.verification, and a failing check can reject a job with no findings, only reasons.
The Script type in the fake driver is Box<dyn Fn(&AgentInvocation) -> FakeTurn + Send + Sync>, so a script can be wrapped to record reader prompts.
